cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook questions Pacheco's stalled title trajectory, but it also describes Fulghum as learning on the job and notes his 1-1-1 stretch before a May win. Both accepted the exact main event at 168 and 167.7, and the WBA's eliminator designation plus Fulghum's 15-1-1 record are meaningful counterweights to dismissing him outright. Direct DraftKings lists Fulghum +650 opposite Pacheco −1200; removing that pair's hold prices Fulghum near 12.6%, roughly +692, so the available underdog quote is short before any extra margin for an unproven thesis.
